2609.39687.title: Better Supervision Is Nearby: Neighborhood On-Policy Self-Distillation
2609.39687.paper_summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains mathematical reasoning models using a privileged teacher that sees a reference solution and supervises student-sampled prefixes. Standard OPSD uses one fixed parameter setting at every state, but nearby settings may offer additional supervision. We find that local parameter perturbations reveal complementary reference-aligned corrections under the same reference context. Different experts supply these corrections at different reference positions. Their pool covers more such positions than the unperturbed privileged teacher. We introduce Neighborhood OPSD (N-OPSD) to turn these corrections into supervision at student-visited states. Offline, greedy selection builds a compact pool of frozen experts by rewarding filtered reference-token gains beyond the pool's current best at each position. The highest-peak expert need not provide the best training target. Online routing therefore separates the anchor direction from its level of support. MaxPeak selects the anchor token, and quantile selection chooses among experts whose top token matches it. The student learns from the chosen expert's full next-token distribution through the clipped forward-KL objective inherited from OPSD. We evaluate on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT February 2025. Across three independent runs per method, Neighborhood OPSD improves the three-benchmark Average@12 over OPSD by 2.75, 1.67, and 1.94 points on Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B, respectively. Student-prefix continuations support using the pool beyond the reference trajectories used for selection. Matched ablations support filtered reference-token gains as a selection criterion. Accounting for overlap within the pool and routing by state further improve student accuracy. Inference uses only the distilled student.
2609.39687.paper_summary_zh: 在政策自蒸餾 (OPSD) 中，使用一個特權教師來訓練數學推理模型，該教師能夠看到參考解決方案並監督學生抽樣的前綴。標準的 OPSD 在每個狀態下使用一個固定的參數設置，但附近的設置可能提供額外的監督。我們發現局部參數擾動在相同的參考上下文下揭示了互補的參考對齊修正。不同的專家在不同的參考位置提供這些修正。他們的池涵蓋了比未擾動的特權教師更多的這些位置。我們引入了鄰域 OPSD (N-OPSD)，將這些修正轉化為在學生訪問的狀態下的監督。離線時，貪婪選擇通過在每個位置上獎勵過濾的參考標記增益，構建一個緊湊的凍結專家池，超過池中當前最佳的增益。最高峰專家不一定提供最佳的訓練目標。因此，線上路由將錨定方向與其支持程度分開。MaxPeak 選擇錨定標記，而分位數選擇則在頂部標記匹配的專家之間進行選擇。學生通過從 OPSD 繼承的裁剪前向 KL 目標學習所選專家的完整下一標記分佈。我們在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025 和 HMMT 2025 年 2 月進行評估。在每種方法的三次獨立運行中，鄰域 OPSD 在 Qwen3-1.7B、4B 和 8B 上，分別將三個基準的 Average@12 提高了 2.75、1.67 和 1.94 分。學生前綴的延續支持在選擇中使用池，超越了參考軌跡。匹配的消融實驗支持過濾的參考標記增益作為選擇標準。考慮到池內的重疊和按狀態路由進一步提高了學生的準確性。推理僅使用蒸餾後的學生。
